# CipherFlux Labs

> CipherFlux Labs (CipherFlux) is an AI and software technology company building next-generation intelligent software products, cybersecurity solutions, and modern digital platforms.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: CipherFlux Labs
- **Alternate Names**: CipherFlux, Cipher Flux, CipherFluxLabs
- **Founded**: 2026
- **Headquarters**: India (Serving Worldwide)
- **Website**: https://cipherfluxlabs.com
- **Email**: hello@cipherfluxlabs.com

## Flagship Products
- **Smith AI**: An AI-powered interview preparation platform designed to help users practice real-time mock interviews, receive instant behavioral feedback, and analyze their performance.
  - URL: https://smith-ai-five.vercel.app
  - Category: AI Career & Interview Preparation
- **Svanexa AI**: An AI-powered women's wellness application designed to help users track cycle patterns, understand health trends, and receive personalized insights with privacy-first encryption.
  - URL: https://hersync-ai.vercel.app
  - Category: AI Women's Wellness & Health

## Core Competencies
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Engineering
- Full-Stack Cloud & Serverless Architectures
- Zero-Trust Cybersecurity & End-to-End Encryption
- Precision Product Design & Modern UI/UX Engineering
